items.expected_conclusion: The hydroxylamine-derived product has a larger computed HOMO-LUMO gap than CSO-CY, approximately 2.99 versus 2.59 eV, and this direction supports the paper’s blue-shift interpretation within the limits of the orbital-gap proxy.
